sources.title_original: Anthropics' Claude cracks a 25-year-old NSA cryptography mystery in under 30 minutes
sources.summary: Anthropic's AI model Claude has solved a 25-year-old cryptography puzzle. The mysterious seeds behind NIST's standard curves for digital signatures were provided by the NSA without explanation, raising long-standing suspicion about built-in backdoors. Claude figured out in under 30 minutes that the seeds came from "lrand48," a simple C random number generator, making deliberate backdoors far less likely. The article Anthropics' Claude cracks a 25-year-old NSA cryptography mystery in under 30 minutes appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic's 人工智慧模型 Claude 破解了一個存在 25 年的密碼學謎題。美國國家安全域性（NSA）當初未加解釋地提供了 NIST 數位簽章標準曲線背後的神秘種子，引發了外界對內建後門的長年懷疑。Claude 在不到 30 分鐘內就弄清楚這些種子來自簡單的 C 語言亂數生成器「lrand48」，這使得刻意設定後門的可能性大幅降低。這篇題為《Anthropic 的 Claude 在不到 30 分鐘內破解了 25 年前的 NSA 密碼學謎團》的文章最初發表在 The Decoder 上。

sources.title_original: Mathematicians say OpenAI doesn't understand its own Navier-Stokes proof
sources.summary: OpenAI submitted a 166-page solution to the Navier-Stokes problem but apparently doesn't fully understand its own proof. Several groups of experts dispute the claimed methodology, saying the actual approach differs from what OpenAI described. And because language models are black boxes, where the underlying ideas came from will likely never be clear. The article Mathematicians say OpenAI doesn't understand its own Navier-Stokes proof appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 針對納維-斯托克斯問題（Navier-Stokes problem）提交了一份 166 頁的解答，但顯然它並不完全理解自己的證明。數個專家團體對其聲稱的方法論提出質疑，表示實際的方法與 OpenAI 所描述的不同。由於語言模型是黑盒子，底層想法究竟從何而來可能永遠無法釐清。這篇題為《數學家表示 OpenAI 並不懂它自己的納維-斯托克斯證明》的文章最初發表在 The Decoder 上。
